description: For domains on Cloudflare DNS. Points www and the bare domain at a Zenpage author website. Cloudflare flattens the bare-domain CNAME. Zenpage applies it without a host; hostRequired is set only because a CNAME at @ requires it (DCTL1012).
variableDescription: site: the Zenpage site name, for example janedoe for janedoe.zenpage.io
